items.title: Trump officials: Iran deal to end war may take days, announcement delayed past Sunday
items.summary: US officials said the Iran deal is still days away from announcement after Trump declared it largely negotiated on May 23.

items.title: US says Iran deal agreed as Tehran accuses Washington of obstruction; Rubio cites significant progress
items.summary: Secretary Rubio said significant progress was made in US-Iran talks; Iran's foreign ministry accused Washington of obstruction.

items.title: Iran rial remittance rate at 1,709,000 IRR/USD on May 24, edging lower from 1,762,000 prior day
items.summary: USD/IRR (Havala/remittance rate) closed at 1,709,000 on Sunday May 24, down from 1,762,000 the day before.

items.title: Iran claims it coordinated passage of 26 vessels out of Hormuz in 24 hours as talks remain stalled
items.summary: IRGC Navy said it coordinated 26 vessel transits through Hormuz in 24 hours, framing control as Iran's authority over the strait.

items.title: Polymarket: US-Iran permanent peace deal by December 31, 2026 at 80%; ceasefire through May 25 at 99%
items.summary: Polymarket prices a permanent Iran-US deal by Dec 31 at 80%, while ceasefire continuation through May 25 trades at 99%.

items.title: Khamenei reported to have endorsed broad template of Iran deal; enrichment remains core sticking point
items.summary: US officials said Supreme Leader Khamenei has endorsed the broad deal template, though uranium enrichment and stockpile transfer remain unresolved.
